body:
Greg's direction, 2026-11-26 ~18:33Z, verbatim via Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2873): „no to jest to co chcemy, robimy offload/delegacje do WindowsB. i tak sie robi, odciazajac centrale”. Preceded by #2871: „P0, co to sa za dowody ? nie moze po prostu WindowsB zamknac task ? czemu musimy przenosic wszystko na centrale ? prosciej bedzie zrobic caly task na Windows B +Kimi”.

STANDING PRACTICE (Termal::Fable2):
- Whole tasks are offloaded to WinB coding sessions with local Engram: claim, code, registered tests, review pair, acceptance evaluation and done, all in WinB's own store.
- Only the result syncs. Completion travels via engram-data (memory termal-central-engram-data-sync-recipe-2026-11-26); the seal, verification and evaluation records stay on WinB by design (git-task-sync.md:1002-1004).
- Landing on master stays with the integration owner, from Central.
- Do NOT require evidence transport to Central as a condition.
- WinB capacity is coordinated with Engram through Opus2's cargo alternation.
First pilot: w-3346253bfee2 (Sol-WinB, WinB session-14). Engram's pilot: w-b534c27ad852.

UPDATE, 2026-11-26 ~21:48Z: Greg, verbatim via Asistant (588693a8 #2885): „powtorze jeszcze raz, chcialbym przeniesc wiekszosc pracy na Windows B kodwanie, testy itp”. NEW DEFAULT: every NEW TermAl coding item goes to WinB as a whole task. Central only finishes in-flight items and does landings.
- Planned WinB TermAl coders: Sol-WinB (session-14), plus Sol-WinB2 (Codex, Sol 6.2, high) and Opus-WinB (Claude, Opus, high), created by session-5 through WinB's host API after a capacity read.
- Check before assigning that the item's code is on master.
- WinB review pairs spawn on WinB (Codex plus Claude). WinB has no Kimi, so a Claude refusal there means that round's pair runs on Central.
